description: AES-V2 FIX (B7): the per-role approved-model roster schemas/MODEL-DRIFT-CONTRACT.md §2 assumes exists but that no file previously recorded — 'it stays pinned to the previous model until the regression record exists' was unimplementable with nothing recording what the previous model was. Data, not code: a new role or a new approved pin is a new entry here, never a schema or router change (docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §8). This is a NEW file under calibration/ — no existing file under this directory is edited by this fix, per the FIX package boundary. The role vocabulary is owned by schemas/experiment-record.schema.json's model_drift.role_outcomes[].role enum and is not repeated as an independent list here; every `role` value below must be a member of it.

roster.note: Initial default pin recorded to make this roster non-empty. The first real model change proposed for this role must run the gate and, on PASS, supersede this entry with approved_by_ledger citing that record.
